title: A/R Detail: the Customer menu ticks several customers and the chip counts them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have two customers, customer A and customer B, with open invoices on today's date; customer B's name is longer than the chip can show.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Click the Customer chip and read the menu from top to bottom.
  2. Type part of customer B's name in the search box.
  3. Tick customer B.
  4. Search for customer A.
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. Expand every group.
  7. In the Customer filter, untick both customers.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens with a search box, an "All customers" row, the line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." and the list of customers.

Step 2:

  • Customer B shows in the list.

Step 3:

  • Customer B is ticked.
  • The chip reads "Customer: " and customer B's name, shortened with "..." because it is long.

Step 4:

  • Customer A shows in the list.

Step 5:

  • Customer A is ticked as well.
  • The chip reads "Customer: 2 customers".

Step 6:

  • Only the two customers' rows remain.

Step 7:

  • No customer is ticked.
  • The chip reads "Customer: All customers" in the resting (grey) style.

The Customer chip is the one Sales By Customer uses: with one name ticked it reads "Customer: " and that name, shortened with "..." when the name is long.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
